title: Seatuck Creek
summary: Seatuck is a creek or river at Eastport on the boundary between Southampton and Brookhaven.
history_content: Seatuck appears frequently in early records as the western boundary of Southampton. The related form Seatquaa referred to a neck of land eastward of Hempstead and is treated as a related form.
translation_content:
Seatuck and Seatquaa are connected with words for the mouth of a tidal stream or land at a creek mouth.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names reflect geographical features and encode ecological knowledge.”

— Mohinur Usmonova, Toponyms as Reflections of Landscape and Environment: Ecological and Geographic Aspects of Place Naming (2025), Abstract
preservation_content: Seatuck marks a boundary creek where town, Native, and colonial land records overlap. Its repeated use in records shows how waterways structured territorial descriptions.
